verdict.line: You lose if he lands W (Path Maker) into a 2-stack Q (Ntofo Strikes) pull before level 6; you win if the lane reaches 9+ minutes with you still on your Doran's Shield sustain.

brief.thesis: K'Sante has the lane and solo-kill edge because his Q (Ntofo Strikes) builds a stack on every hit and fires a pulling shockwave at 2 stacks, and his W (Path Maker) adds a knockback-stun on top of that — he has hard engage, you don't, until you've stacked three hits of An Acquired Taste on him. Your counter isn't winning trades, it's surviving them: E (Thick Skin) banks damage into a shield, and R (Devour) is a 0-cooldown answer that either eats him for free magic damage once stacked or eats an ally out of his All Out burst.

theirWindow.when: His W (Path Maker) visibly charges up
theirWindow.what: He's taking reduced damage during the charge and about to dash into a knockback-stun — don't trade into the charge, and assume a Q (Ntofo Strikes) pull is coming right after if he's already at 1 stack.

yourWindow.when: You've landed 3 stacks of An Acquired Taste on him
yourWindow.what: Either Q (Tongue Lash) him again to stun and consume the stacks for a free follow-up trade, or fire R (Devour) immediately — 0 cooldown, pure magic damage, and it removes him from the fight for a few seconds, which is devastating if he just activated R (All Out).

powerCurve.note: Early Q+W combo threatens all-in before you have stacks
W stun plus Q pull punishes shallow trades
R (Devour) and W (Abyssal Dive) come online
Heartsteel HP stacks make Thick Skin shields real

start.why: 47.5% win rate over 122 games and the 73.9% pick for a reason — the passive block and sustain neutralize K'Sante's poke-heavy Q (Ntofo Strikes) trades before you have any stacks built.

boots.why: 46.3% win rate over 80 games and the majority pick at 54.1% — K'Sante's entire kit is physical autos and Q (Ntofo Strikes) hits, so flat auto-attack reduction matters more here than magic resist boots.

core.why: First item on the highest-win-rate core path (63.6% over 11 games) — stacks HP, which directly scales both your passive attack damage and your E (Thick Skin) shield size.
Second item on that same 63.6% path — more HP and sustain to out-scale K'Sante's all-in windows into the mid game.
Closes out the 63.6% win-rate path — adds magic penetration and omnivamp so your Q (Tongue Lash) poke and Devour (R) damage actually matter in extended fights.

situational.when: the game is going long and you're leaning on Thick Skin (E) and Devour (R) sustain to out-heal his All Out damage
K'Sante's All Out (R) healing is keeping him alive through fights you should be winning
he's auto-attacking you down in lane before you've stacked three hits of An Acquired Taste

runes.keystoneWhy: Procs on autos every 4 seconds for bonus damage and max-health scaling, which stacks the same way your passive and E (Thick Skin) shield do — every trade you take adds to your HP-based power instead of just being a loss.

summoners.why: Flash+Ignite is the highest win-rate combo at 51.7% and the majority pick at 51.5% — Ignite punishes his early all-in attempts and secures the kill once you've stunned him with a stacked Q (Tongue Lash).

playing.title: Hold Q (Tongue Lash) at max range
playing.detail: It's a 900-range poke that slows, heals you on champion hit, and guarantees a stack of An Acquired Taste — use it to build toward the 3-stack stun without walking into his Q (Ntofo Strikes) range.

playing.title: Never trade into his W charge
playing.detail: K'Sante takes reduced damage while W (Path Maker) is charging, so any damage you throw in during that window is wasted — back off and wait for the dash to resolve before reengaging.

playing.title: Pop E (Thick Skin) before the stun lands
playing.detail: If you see his W (Path Maker) finish charging or his Q (Ntofo Strikes) hit 2 stacks, convert your stored damage into a shield immediately — it's only a 3-second cooldown so you can afford to use it defensively and refresh it.

playing.title: Save R (Devour) for his All Out
playing.detail: If you can stack 3 hits on him before he activates R (All Out), eating him with Devour right as he transforms cuts his damage window short entirely — his reduced defenses during All Out make the magic damage hit harder too.

playing.title: Devour an ally to deny his All Out kill
playing.detail: R (Devour) also works on allies as a shield-and-hide — if K'Sante's All Out (R) is about to land on your carry, swallowing them removes the target entirely.

playing.title: Don't force kills in lane
playing.detail: Solo-kill advantage is his, not yours — play for sustain and scaling with Doran's Shield and Grasp stacks rather than looking for an early all-in you don't have the burst for.

playing.title: Track his E (Footwork) cooldown
playing.detail: 10 to 8 seconds depending on rank — when it's down he has no dash and no shield, which is your safest window to commit to a full Q-auto trade.

brief.patchCaveat: The build, runes, summoners, and all win-rate figures above are measured from live games on the current patch (16.20.1) via OP.GG; the ability breakdowns, timing windows, and tactical reasoning are my own analysis layered on top of that data.
